# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.1

First database-lifecycle preview based on the tested RX Tracker 3.3.1 feature
set. The UI and RX Softphone protocol are unchanged.

Highlights:

- explicit, compiled-compatible database create/migrate/verify/adopt tooling;
- checksum-verified migration history that rejects edits to applied migrations;
- read-only schema validation during normal web startup;
- audited migration for legacy startup-created tables, columns, indexes, and
  backfills;
- guarded dump restoration and v3.3.1 adoption;
- validated test-copy sanitization and aggregate-only comparison;
- first-admin bootstrap with no known default password.
- PostgreSQL 17 CI for provisioning, sanitized adoption rehearsals, regressions,
  and read-only web-runtime validation.

This preview is for isolated development and rehearsals. Keep RX Tracker 3.3.1
frozen as the production fallback until the documented promotion gates pass.
